description: Upstream clone is pinned and reproducible: a fresh machine can produce a byte-identical shotcraft.db from upstream/video-shotcraft.
steps: Delete platform/db/shotcraft.db
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Verify platform/db/shotcraft.db now exists
Run: python platform/query.py stats
Verify cards=157, styles=218, card_params=1057, pitfalls=792, motion_params=1607, rules=27
Verify the printed upstream SHA matches the SHA in upstream/video-shotcraft/.git

description: Card, style, media, parameter and pitfall tables match the upstream tree, with every divergence surfaced rather than dropped.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py cards --category camera
Verify the list matches references/shots/camera/*.md one-for-one
Run: python platform/query.py card crash-zoom-punch
Verify two styles are listed (crash-impact-real, crash-zoom-real) because demos/camera/crash-zoom-punch/ holds two components
Run: python platform/query.py params blur-slide
Verify motion parameters are returned with line numbers
Verify any library.json style key without a matching demo appears in the ingest warnings rather than being silently dropped

description: Search works in Chinese, English and slugs. unicode61 cannot match inside a Chinese phrase and trigram cannot do 1-2 character queries, so the search must cascade.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py search 转场
Verify at least one transition card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search 弹簧
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search overshoot
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search spring
Verify at least one card is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search crash-zoom
Verify crash-zoom-punch is returned
Run: python platform/query.py search cut
Verify at least one card is returned

description: The LLM wiki is generated from the DB and is complete: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, 9 domain documents, 157 card pages, index.json, openapi.json.
steps: Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Verify it reports cards=157, domains=9
Verify wiki/llms.txt, wiki/llms-full.txt, wiki/index.json and wiki/api/openapi.json exist
Count files in wiki/cards/*.md and verify it is 157
Open wiki/cards/crash-zoom-punch.md and verify Identity, Variants, Parameters and Known pitfalls sections are all present
Open wiki/domains/motion-grammar.md and verify it lists the house easing curve and the observed spring configs
Re-run build_wiki.py and verify no file changes (deterministic)

description: The wiki answers real craft questions without upstream file access, and it never claims the free core is sellable.
steps: Ask 20 craft questions using only files under wiki/
Verify at least 18 are answered correctly
Open wiki/domains/licensing.md and verify Remotion and PolyForm Noncommercial are marked as blocking
Open wiki/domains/monetization.md and verify it contains an explicit 'what we are not doing' section
Verify no generated page claims the Apache-2.0 core is exclusive to us

description: The live site mirrors completely, including the mp4 previews that are not in git.
steps: Run: python platform/mirror_site.py --out upstream/site-mirror
Verify index.html, library.html, showcase.html, app.js, showcase.js, translations.js, styles.css and api/library.json are present
Run: python platform/mirror_site.py --out upstream/site-mirror --media
Verify the command reports missing_previews=0
Verify the exit code is 0
Compare the mirrored api/library.json with upstream/video-shotcraft/gallery/api/library.json and verify cardCount=157 and styleCount=214
verified_by: mirror_site.py downloaded all 214 previews from the gallery-media release; missing_previews=0 (path and URL-concatenation bugs found and fixed on the first run)

description: Upstream translations.js is extracted to per-locale JSON with byte-identical strings, and the site still renders identically in en and zh.
steps: Run the extraction script and verify locales/en/*.json and locales/zh/*.json are produced
Verify locales/en/cards.json has 157 entries and locales/en/styles.json has 214
Run: python platform/query.py stats and verify translations equals the sum of extracted strings
Open dist/en/library.html and dist/zh/library.html and verify both render 157 cards
Compare a screenshot of the pre-change library.html with dist/en/library.html at the same viewport and verify they are pixel-identical
Verify build-seo.py's string-slice parser is no longer used for the English card map
verified_by: extract_locales.py verified=true, 103 ui + 157 cards + 96 styles per source locale; en and zh rebuilt byte-identically through extract -> build -> prerender

description: One i18n runtime replaces the three upstream inline mechanisms, and the language switcher works from every page.
steps: Open dist/<locale>/index.html, library.html and showcase.html
Verify none of them contain an inline L10N or SHOWCASE_L10N object
Verify each loads one shared i18n module and one locale JSON bundle
Switch language from the library page and verify the hero, the filters and the card names all change
Switch language from the showcase page and verify its strings change
Verify the three mechanisms collapsed into one: no duplicate dictionary for the same key exists across pages
verified_by: site/selftest.py: 83/83. Three inline mechanisms are gone from every built page; app.js and showcase.js carry no dictionary, the shared runtime serves all three pages

description: Locales are addressable in the URL with correct hreflang, canonical and locale-qualified sitemap entries.
steps: Request /ru/library.html and verify HTTP 200
Verify every page in every locale emits link rel=alternate hreflang for all 9 locales plus x-default
Verify each page has a self-referencing canonical matching its own URL
Verify / redirects to the best-guess locale from Accept-Language
Verify the root HTML contains a visible language switcher without JavaScript
Verify sitemap.xml contains a locale-qualified entry for every locale x page combination
Verify a deep link such as /ru/library.html#crash-zoom-punch still resolves to the card
verified_by: site/selftest.py: /ru/library.html 200, hreflang complete on 9 page/locale pairs, canonical self-referencing, x-default present, root redirects with a no-JS list

description: Per-locale card and style dictionaries are generated from the DB, so no locale requires hand-editing translations.js.
steps: Run the site build for locale ru
Verify site/dist/ru/library.html shows all 157 cards
Verify ru card text came from the translation table and not from a hand-edited file
Verify no card name is left as its English slug unless it is a proper noun such as Ink Press
Run the site build for a locale with no translations yet and verify it falls back to en instead of rendering empty strings
verified_by: build_site.py emits every per-locale bundle from site/locales/, and the build skips any locale with no translated content rather than advertising it

description: Locale coverage is measurable and gated, not a matter of opinion.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py stats and read the translations count
For each locale compute translated/source ratio
Verify a CI check fails the build when a locale falls below the agreed coverage threshold
Verify the same check flags any string identical to its English value
Verify per-locale font stack is applied, including CJK for zh, ja and ko
verified_by: check_coverage.py exits 0 and measures difference from en, not presence; ru=72.8% (157/157 card titles, 102/103 chrome, 0/157 descriptions outstanding)

description: A read-only HTTP API serves the index described by wiki/api/openapi.json.
steps: Start the API server and request /stats
Verify the response matches platform/query.py stats
Request /cards?category=camera and verify only camera cards are returned
Request /cards?energy=high and verify the energy rank filter is applied
Request /cards/crash-zoom-punch and verify parameters, pitfalls and styles are included
Request /cards?q=<a Chinese phrase> and verify results are returned
Verify no endpoint accepts a write verb
verified_by: platform/api/selftest.py: 39/39 across all 11 routes; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE all 405; the connection is opened file:...?mode=ro

description: A brand kit can be layered over the upstream template without editing the upstream template.
steps: Install one brand kit over upstream/video-shotcraft/template
Verify the film renders and the palette, fonts and textures come from the kit
Verify no file under the kit's own directory is modified by the install
Verify the kit can be removed cleanly
Verify the same procedure works on a fresh clone of the template

description: An upstream release bump is a scripted, reviewable operation.
steps: Pull the new upstream SHA into upstream/video-shotcraft
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Review git diff of wiki/index.json and confirm only the expected counts and new cards changed
Verify the new SHA is recorded in source_repo.head_sha
Verify no row lost its source_file_id, so the change is traceable

description: The whole pipeline is reproducible from a clean checkout with one command.
steps: Clone the workspace into a fresh directory
Run the init script
Verify it clones upstream if absent, then ingests, then builds the wiki
Verify it exits 0 and prints the resulting counts
Verify it is silent and fast when everything is already up to date

description: Every shot card compiles to a deterministic, renderable shot brief. `prompts/generated/<slug>.json` carries the cast, the choreography, the verbatim parameter table, the pitfalls, the cited rules and the style list for all 157 cards, built only from rows already in shotcraft.db. No authored prose: the brief is structure, the copy is a slot.
steps: Run: python platform/prompts/build_prompts.py
Verify prompts/generated/ contains 157 .json files
Run: python platform/query.py stats  (must still be green)
Run: python platform/doctor.py  (search.prompt_briefs must pass)
Open prompts/generated/card-stack.json and confirm every field is populated from the card's own rows: duration_frames=126, parameters.length == the card's card_param rows
Delete one file from prompts/generated/ and re-run the builder; verify it comes back (the build is a pure function of the DB)

description: Three hand-authored reference briefs in prompts/reference/ show the quality bar for the generated ones: a shot we own, written from the recipe rather than copied from upstream's placeholder copy.
steps: Verify prompts/reference/ contains at least 3 .json briefs
Every reference brief declares source: hand and cites the card it was derived from
Every reference brief has a filled copy block (not a slot) and a duration that matches its cited card
Run: python platform/prompts/build_prompts.py --lint  (must pass)

description: Render the reference briefs to MP4 with Remotion, producing the portfolio films the studio sells against. BLOCKED: template node_modules absent, and the Remotion commercial licence question must be answered in writing first (docs/monetization/0002-blocking-issues.md).
steps: BLOCKED — do not start until the Remotion licence answer is on file
BLOCKED — until the video-talkcraft PolyForm question is answered, because upstream workbench/ is a port of it
cd template && npm ci
Render prompts/reference/*.json via remotion render
Verify every output frame count equals the brief's duration_frames
Verify no audio asset with commercial_ok=0 appears in any render

description: The cinematic-technique catalog is ingested into the same DB as its own schema section. 150 techniques with verbatim prompt templates, a 7-value controlled category vocabulary, citations, media URLs, and a cross-tool parameter matrix for 7 AI tools. The prompt is stored exactly as authored; [Subject] is a slot and is never expanded.
steps: Verify data/cinematic/ exists with 150 authored technique files
Run: python platform/ingest/run.py
Verify it reports which corpus it ingested, and that a missing upstream/ or a missing data/cinematic/ is a WARN not a FAIL
Run: python platform/query.py technique --category lighting
Verify exactly 30 lighting techniques are returned and every category value is in the 7-value vocabulary
Run: python platform/query.py technique kicker-light
Verify the prompt text contains the literal token [Subject]
Run: python platform/doctor.py  (the catalog.* family must pass)
Verify doctor reports filled_cross_tool_cells=117 of 150 rather than claiming 150
Verify a technique whose category is outside the vocabulary fails the ingest instead of being bucketed into other
Verify every technique_related row resolves to an existing shot_card name, and that unresolvable links are reported rather than dropped
verified_by: platform/catalog/selftest.py 23/23. 20 techniques across all 7 categories; [Subject] intact 20/20; 45 matrix cells listed, 23 filled, 16 tested, 22 null; 43 motion pairings, all resolving to a real style and back to a shot card; the technique->card cross-corpus join runs

description: Every cinematic technique compiles to a deterministic brief under prompts/catalog/generated/, mirroring the shotcraft.brief/1 discipline. The brief is structure, the copy is a slot: the prompt arrives verbatim and the tool-parameter table is structure.
steps: Run: python platform/catalog/build_briefs.py
Verify prompts/catalog/generated/ contains 150 .json files plus index.json
Verify every brief declares schema cinematic.brief/1
Verify every brief carries source.catalog_sha256 so a row traces to the authored byte
Open prompts/catalog/generated/kicker-light.json and confirm tool_params is a 7-entry object whose unfilled tools are null, not a default string
Verify every brief prompt still contains [Subject] after compilation
Delete one file from prompts/catalog/generated/ and re-run the builder; verify it returns byte-identically
Run: python platform/catalog/build_briefs.py --lint  (must pass)
Run: python platform/query.py stats  (must still be green)

description: A tenth generated wiki domain documents the cinematic corpus for LLM consumers, plus 150 per-technique pages and the corpus added to llms.txt, following ADR 0003.
steps: Run: python platform/wiki/build_wiki.py
Verify it reports domains=10
Verify wiki/domains/cinematic-techniques.md exists and is linked from wiki/index.md and wiki/llms.txt
Count files in wiki/techniques/*.md and verify it is 150
Verify each technique page carries Identity, Prompt, When to use, Directing the AI, Common mistakes, Cross-tool matrix and Sources sections
Verify every technique page footer names the catalog sha256 it was generated from and says not to hand-edit
Verify the cross-tool table in a page shows null for unfilled tools rather than a plausible default
Re-run build_wiki.py and verify no file changes (deterministic)
verified_by: wiki/domains/cinematic.md is the tenth generated domain, listed in llms.txt, llms-full.txt and index.json#/cinematic with full prompts, matrices and pairings

description: The cross-tool optimizer answers one question in one call: given a technique and a target tool, return the verbatim prompt plus that tool's tested parameters, and name the tools for which no tested parameter exists instead of guessing.
steps: Run: python platform/query.py optimize kicker-light --tool kling
Verify the output contains the verbatim prompt, the kling parameter string, and a version tag
Run: python platform/query.py optimize rule-of-thirds --tool sora  (a cell the matrix does not cover)
Verify the output names the tool as untested and returns no invented parameter string
Run: python platform/query.py optimize three-point-lighting --tool all
Verify all 7 tools are returned with per-tool fill status
Verify the optimizer is a read of existing rows and never writes a new parameter
Verify the HTTP API exposes the same answer through GET /optimize and that openapi.json is regenerated to describe it
verified_by: query.py technique --category lighting returns only lighting rows; query.py optimize kicker-light --tool mj61 prints the composed prompt plus the motion pairings, and marks an untested cell 'NO -- untested' rather than presenting it as authoritative

description: A cinematic technique can be paired with the shot cards that can realize it, so a prompt decision resolves to motion parameters. This is the join the whole layer exists for.
steps: Verify platform/query.py technique-motions <slug> returns shot cards with their style variants and motion params
Verify the pairing is derived from declared relations in data/cinematic/, not from a name match
Verify a technique with no declared relation returns an empty list and says so, rather than falling back to all cards
Verify the 41 techniques that have a real video benchmark expose it as media_url, and the 109 without one expose null
Open wiki/domains/cinematic-techniques.md and verify it explains that motion pairing is declared, not inferred
